statusMeaning.candidate: reported by a discovery auditor, not yet checked
statusMeaning.verified: an independent verifier reproduced or confirmed it against the real code
statusMeaning.refuted: the verifier showed it does not happen
statusMeaning.unconfirmed: could not be reproduced or decided
statusMeaning.fixed: fixed on this branch with a regression test
statusMeaning.deferred: verified but left for a decision or a later pass

findings.title: After the first game, the main menu's controller handler is never re-armed; once Settings or Records is opened and closed on that menu, D-pad, A and B stop working
findings.scenario: Controller only: boot, play any mode, return to the main menu, open Settings (Start) or Records and close with B → D-pad/stick/A/B do nothing on the main menu; only Start and View work; a Steam invite toast stops answering A/B (isInLivePlay true). Even before a sheet, the second visit runs on the generic handler (no right-stick scroll, B no longer returns to mode list).
findings.evidence: main.js:5041 only call of enableGameModeSelection (boot); main.js:2728 disableGameModeSelection on every mode start; ModalManager.show('start') enables menu nav (modals.js:156) but hide() of settings/highScores/demoComplete calls disableMenuNavigation (modals.js:188); resumeGame returns early while start modal visible. Poll routing gamepad-controller.js:858-868 → processGamepadInput (gameplay). Scratch test with real ModalManager+GamepadController: routes {selection:0, menu:0, gameplay:1}.
findings.fixSketch: Tie game-mode-selection to the start modal: enable on ModalManager.show('start'), disable on hide('start') (or derive in poll); don't disableMenuNavigation on sheet hide while the start modal is visible.
findings.testIdea: ModalManager+GamepadController with stub DOM: boot show start, mode start, return, show/hide settings, D-pad down → processGameModeSelection called (current: processGamepadInput).
findings.knownCheck: Not recorded (INPUT-03 is a different edge-state wipe; CONTROLLER_UX §2 check covered the first visit only).

verification.summary: jsdom with the real index.html, GamepadController, ModalManager, setupModalUI, showHighScoresModal (verify/ui/p1-menu-rearm.test.mjs). First visit after Settings: routes {selection:3}, A clicked the card. Second visit after Start+B on Settings: flags {sel:false, nav:false}, routes {gameplay:9}, card clicks [], A/B/Down → rotate/hardDrop/softDrop. Records + B: same. Nothing in src re-sets the flags. Fix: ModalManager.show('start') enables game-mode selection; hide('start') disables it.

findings.title: The pad press that finishes a binding capture also acts on Settings: View closes Settings and opens the Hub; Start/LB/RB/D-pad can close Settings, switch tab or move focus
findings.scenario: Settings › Controls › Controller › Pause, A to listen, press View → binding saved, then the same held press closes Settings and opens the Serenity Hub (mid-run: resume then pause again). Start to bind Pause closes Settings ~1 in 6 times; LB/RB can switch tab; D-pad can move focus.
findings.evidence: settings.js:940 capture interval 50 ms; cancel() (:919) removes .listening; noteCaptureEnded (:346) stamps data-capture-ended; processMenuNavigation latches only while .listening (gamepad-controller.js:1633), never latching serenityToggleHub; processMenuHubButton (:1021) not called during capture → held View is a fresh edge (:1029-1034). Only B checks data-capture-ended (:2005); A covered by captureJustEnded (settings.js:2401). Scratch tests: View → ['close-settings','hub']; Start → ['close-settings'].
findings.fixSketch: Treat a recent data-capture-ended (~300 ms) like .listening (latch all held buttons incl. hub/start/shoulders), or keep .listening until the answering button is released.
findings.testIdea: Poll with .listening and View held, remove .listening, poll again with View held → close-settings not clicked, toggleHub not called.
findings.knownCheck: INPUT_HOLD_UP_2026-10:44 fixed input while listening, not the press that ends capture; not recorded.

verification.summary: verify/ui/c2-capture-press.test.mjs with real handleGamepadBinding/GamepadController/ModalManager: Pause←View: bound, Settings closed, Hub toggled once; Pause←Start (interval first): Settings closed; RB: tab general→display. Binding always saved correctly; side effect only → P3. Fix: in processMenuNavigation treat listening OR data-capture-ended < 300 ms as capture-owned and latch hub/start too.

findings.title: The controller's 100 ms first-focus pass runs on every main-menu show, even with no pad connected, and moves focus to the first mode card, so the menu forgets the remembered mode
findings.scenario: Play Odyssey/Infinity and return to the main menu (or boot with a remembered mode): 100 ms after ModalManager.show('start'), enableMenuNavigation focuses getFirstFocusableElement() = #single-player-card-btn regardless of pads or current focus → Single Player becomes current (stage/light/world switch, hover blip); Records then opens on Single Player. main-menu's 160 ms focusCurrentForKeys then refocuses 'single'.
findings.evidence: gamepad-controller.js:1571-1606 unconditional setTimeout(100); getMenuSheet() null for start modal → document-wide first focusable; modals.js:156; main-menu.js:379 focus → setCurrent(mode,{immediate:true}); main-menu.js:493; modals.js:696 pickRecordsMode reads dataset.current; index.html focusables before #start-modal hidden. Scratch test (no pad, focus on Odyssey card) → Single focused after 120 ms. Not checked in a real browser.
findings.fixSketch: In the timer, skip when the shown modal is the start modal or focus is already inside the open sheet/modal; only when a pad is connected or input mode is gamepad.
findings.testIdea: Stub doc with 3 cards, focus third, no pad; enableMenuNavigation; advance 120 ms → focus unchanged.
findings.knownCheck: Not recorded.

verification.summary: verify/ui/c3-first-focus.test.mjs, real main-menu.js (lastMode odyssey), no pad: current odyssey at 90 ms → single at 120 ms; keyboard user same. Fix: in the timer return when getMenuSheet() is null (main-menu.js places its own focus). Related: processGameModeSelection's unfocused branch focuses gameModeCards[selectedGameModeIndex||0], not the .is-current card.

findings.title: Start from the Hub within 500 ms of opening Settings closes the Hub but Settings never opens: game stays paused with nothing on screen
findings.scenario: In a run: Start (Settings opens, 500 ms cooldown armed), View (Settings closes, Hub opens), Start again within 500 ms → Hub closes without resuming, toggleSettings hits the cooldown and returns; paused game with no Hub and no Settings.
findings.evidence: gamepad-controller.js:2058-2063 _toggleCooldown on every open; Hub branch calls callbacks.closeForSettings() = hide({resumeGameplay:false}) (SerenityHub.js:1064) then toggleSettings(slot) (:3195-3199). Scratch test: hubOpen=false, paused=true, settingsVisible=false.
findings.fixSketch: Hub→Settings handoff bypasses the debounce, or clear the cooldown when Settings closes.
findings.testIdea: Start, View over settings, Start with Hub open ~350 ms after first Start → settings button clicked.
findings.knownCheck: CONTROLLER_UX_2026-11 records the handoff without the cooldown interaction; not recorded.

verification.summary: verify/ui/c4-hub-start-cooldown.test.mjs: second Start at ~350 ms → hub closed, settings not visible, paused; at ~650 ms opens. Soft lock (another Start/Escape recovers). Fix: clear _toggleCooldown before toggleSettings in the Hub branch.

findings.title: Stillfall's own pad loop ignores window focus: with 'Pause when the game loses focus' off, presses made in another app undo, restart or advance the puzzle
findings.scenario: Focus-pause off, Stillfall puzzle on the board, alt-tab with the game window still visible and use the controller elsewhere: LB undoes, RB restarts, A after a solve loads the next puzzle.
findings.evidence: StillfallHud.watchPad (580-590) own rAF loop; pollPad (591-612) only gates on covered() (505); PAD (39-41); GamepadController.poll gates on document.hasFocus() (gamepad-controller.js:750-760) because Chromium reports pads to background windows; stillfall-pad-list.js also resets when unfocused.
findings.fixSketch: In pollPad keep updating padPrev but take no action while document.hidden or !document.hasFocus(); latch buttons held on refocus.
findings.testIdea: Stub getGamepads LB pressed, hasFocus false, active puzzle; pollPad twice with an edge → send('undo') not called.
findings.knownCheck: Main poll's background fix recorded; this second loop not.

verification.summary: verify/ui/c5-stillfall-unfocused.test.mjs, real installStillfallHud with hasFocus false: sent ['undo','restart','next']; main controller 0 calls. Needs non-default setting + visible unfocused window. Fix: skip actions when document.hidden or !hasFocus (keep updating padPrev).

findings.title: LB/RB (and Q/E) in Settings opened over Records also switch the Records tab hidden beneath
findings.scenario: Records open, Start opens Settings over it, RB → Settings changes tab and so does Records underneath (re-reads scores); after closing Settings Records shows a different mode. Keyboard Q/E does the same.
findings.evidence: switchMainTab (gamepad-controller.js:1842-1893) doesn't return after the Settings branch; continues to Records branch (next.click()). Records Q/E listener (modals.js:799-808) checks only Records visible, ignores defaultPrevented / Settings on top.
findings.fixSketch: switchMainTab acts only on the top sheet and returns; Records Q/E listener returns when defaultPrevented or #settings-modal visible.
findings.testIdea: Both modals visible; switchMainTab(1) → only Settings tab clicked.
findings.knownCheck: Not recorded.

verification.summary: verify/ui/c6-tabs-under-settings.test.mjs: pad RB {single,general}→{infinity,display}; keyboard E → {odyssey,audio}. Fix: return after Settings branch in switchMainTab; Records Q/E listener returns when #settings-modal visible.

findings.title: Steam Cloud: a first device with no Odyssey save keeps an Odyssey upload stuck forever, blocking every later Odyssey download to it
findings.scenario: First cloud device A has no Odyssey save. First sync finds no manifest → _pushAllLocal queues odyssey.json → _flushUploadEntries' Odyssey branch gets null from _exportOdyssey() and throws ('could not be preserved'); entry is re-queued and persisted. Device B uploads Odyssey progress. A restarts: _syncFile(odyssey.json) sees the pending entry, _flushPendingUploads throws again, returns at 461 without downloading. A's local Odyssey save never arrives: fresh journey at Orb 1, menu/Records show no progress, breath worlds stay locked, until A's first own Odyssey save.
findings.evidence: steam-cloud-sync.js _flushUploadEntries 330-405, syncFromCloud 410-440, _syncFile 444-470, _applyOdyssey 806-831 (handles missing local via {version} at 816), _exportOdyssey 1128-1138, _pushAllLocal 1264-1270. Throwaway vitest with real SteamCloudSyncManager + OdysseyStateManager over in-memory cloud: pending stays ['odyssey.json'], A completedLevels.size 0 (expected 2).
findings.fixSketch: Odyssey upload branch with local null: if remote has data apply it (_applyOdyssey merges against {version}) then upload union; if both absent drop pending entry. Skip queueing files whose local payload is null in _pushAllLocal.
findings.testIdea: A syncs to empty cloud without Odyssey save; B completes two orbs and uploads; A restarts and syncs. Expect 2 completions and no pending odyssey.json.
findings.knownCheck: Searched 11-06 (persistence, passes 2-4, remaining 1 and 8), pass-02/03 deferred JSONs, 10-13 SCORE-01/04/11/12, 10-22, 10-03, plan: no record.

verification.summary: verify/gameplay/p1-cloud-odyssey-stuck.test.js (real SteamCloudSyncManager + OdysseyStateManager, in-memory cloud): A pending ['odyssey.json'] forever, local save null, completedLevels 0 after B uploads 2; fresh device control downloads both. Precondition near-universal for a new player's first device. Fix: Odyssey branch with local null: apply remote via _applyOdyssey if it parses (then drop/ack), drop if both absent; keep throw when the remote read itself fails (lifetime tests rely on it). No data loss; heals on A's first Odyssey save.

findings.title: An imported replay older than every stored replay is deleted by the retention prune of its own save, while the sheet says 'Replay imported.'
findings.scenario: At MAX_STORED_DEMOS=200 (every Single Player game auto-saves a replay), importing a replay file keeps its original timestamp; saveDemo adds row 201, _pruneOldDemos walks index('timestamp') oldest-first and deletes the just-imported row. demo-browser reports 'Replay imported.' but it's gone. Exporting a PB replay to keep it and re-importing later is exactly the failing case.
findings.evidence: DemoManager.saveDemo 52-79, _pruneOldDemos 85-109, importFromJSON 199-213 (keeps timestamp, drops id), demo-browser.js handleFileImport 355-369. Throwaway vitest with in-memory IDB stand-in: row 201 gone after save.
findings.fixSketch: Prune in save order (store.openCursor() on autoIncrement keys), or at minimum never delete the id this save just added.
findings.testIdea: Fill store with 200 recent replays, save an imported one dated a month ago; loadDemo(returnedId) must return it.
findings.knownCheck: SCORE-13 (PB replays pruned after 200 games), UI-08, 11-06 fix #10 (prune durability) don't cover an import pruned by its own save.

verification.summary: verify/gameplay/p2-import-pruned.test.js: import id 201, loadDemo(201) undefined, rows 200. Fix: prune in save order via store.openCursor() over autoIncrement ids (no schema change); replay-storage-transaction.test.js harness needs store.openCursor. Downgraded: niche, only at the 200 cap, source file untouched.

findings.title: Replay results rank and career stats mix Infinity runs into Single Player (getRank/getStatistics without a mode)
findings.scenario: showDemoCompleteModal (Single Player replays only) calls highScoreManager.getRank(score) with no mode → counts all modes; Career/session cards use lifetime totals across modes. A player with 60 Infinity runs ≥90k watching their 50k Single Player best replay sees 'Rank #61' instead of 'New record', and Infinity-mixed career figures. The game-over modal ranks per mode (modals.js:405-406).
findings.evidence: modals.js showGameOverModal 354-420 (per-mode at 405-406), showDemoCompleteModal 581-640 (getRank(score) 615, getStatistics() 616); high-scores.js getRank 338-351 counts index('score') across modes; DemoRecorder only records from SinglePlayerMode.
findings.fixSketch: Choose mode like showGameOverModal; getRank(score,{mode}) and statisticsForMode(await getStatistics(), mode).
findings.testIdea: Fake highScoreManager: getRank → 61 without mode, 1 with {mode:'single'}; expect 'New record' and single-mode career figures.
findings.knownCheck: SCORE-06/UI-07 (10-13) fixed game-over/Records/menu per mode; replay results path missed; no separate record.

verification.summary: verify/gameplay/p3-demo-rank-mode.test.js: getRank called with no mode → 'Rank #61'; career mixes 90,059 Infinity best. Fix: mode as in showGameOverModal; getRank(score,{mode}); statisticsForMode. Display only → P3.

findings.title: Replay: resuming while a line clear is still animating starts a second frame loop; recorded inputs are applied twice and the next one skipped
findings.scenario: Replay at ≤1x; a lock clears a line; _loop awaits _advanceTo → _waitForPhysics while the cascade pacer waits ~250-600 ms/wave; animationId is already null. Viewer pauses and resumes in that window (double-click play/pause, two pad A presses, pause sheet open/close). resumePlayback → _scheduleLoop checks only animationId → second _loop with same seekToken. Both read demo.inputs[currentInputIndex] before either increments: one input applied twice, next skipped; replay diverges; runtime checkpoints capture the diverged board.
findings.evidence: DemoPlayer.js:240-248 (since b58561c, 2026-11-06), :418-426 (_scheduleLoop guards animationId only; nulled at :423 before _loop), :371-410, :466-475; physics.js:194-212 pacer waits when not seeking; callers playback-controls.js:211-218, SinglePlayerMode.js:500-502. Repro: applied [move:-1, move:-1, rotate:left, rotate:left] vs recorded [move:-1, move:1, rotate:left, move:-1]. demo-playback-ownership.test.js (9/9) doesn't cover it.
findings.fixSketch: Track a running loop (_loopRunning set at _loop entry, cleared in finally before rescheduling); _scheduleLoop no-ops while set.
findings.testIdea: Stub RAF and a pending latestPhysicsPromise; _loop(), pause, resume, run queued frame, resolve, flush; each input applied exactly once in order.
findings.knownCheck: 11-06 independent-review row (d741361/b58561c) only records Play restarting the loop after a paused seek; not recorded elsewhere. Regression from b58561c.

verification.summary: verify/gameplay/c1-demo-double-loop.test.js (real DemoPlayer/GameState/hardDrop/pacer, fake timers): same-frame inputs → move:1 applied twice, rotate:left never; digest 39520102 vs 9763456b. Any concurrent loop also rewrites the replay clock (first spawn after clear at sim 159.7 vs 303 ms; score 381 vs 386). Regression from b58561c. Fix must be token-scoped (a plain boolean can stall after seek()/startPlayback retire a loop): _runningLoopToken set in _loop, cleared in finally only if equal and before its own reschedule; _scheduleLoop returns while _runningLoopToken === seekToken. Separate older issue: a pause lasting until the cascade ends lets _advanceTo count same-frame inputs as applied while isPaused rejects them.

findings.title: Garbage settling can complete a row that nothing clears; the victim's next lock clears it and is credited for it
findings.scenario: Local versus (and Odyssey duels / rising tide via applyGarbage): a one-column body resting in column c; garbage rows with their hole in c arrive; settleFloatingBlocksAfterGarbage drops the body into the aligned holes completing rows; linesAfterInsertion reports them but every caller ignores it. Full rows sit uncleared until the victim's next lock, which clears them as the victim's own clear: lines, score, level, Odyssey line goals, and an outgoing attack.
findings.evidence: garbage.js:710-731; game.js:540-553 passes result; callers ignore it: main.js:4528-4561, OdysseyBotMatch.js:157-164, GameplayHybridEngine.js:321-328; physics.js:709-712 clears any full row on next lock. Repro: 1×2 body at x=3 + one garbage row hole at 3 → row 23 full; next hard drop elsewhere: lines 0→1, score up, onGarbageReady depth 1.
findings.fixSketch: Owner rules decision: clear+settle inside applyGarbage without credit, or prevent the settle from completing a garbage row.
findings.testIdea: garbage-boundary.test.js: body at col 3, applyGarbage hole col 3 → no full row; next non-clearing lock leaves gs.lines unchanged.
findings.knownCheck: Not recorded; ADR-0011 governs cascade waves after a lock, not garbage insertion.

verification.summary: verify/gameplay/c2-garbage-settle-full-row.test.js: 1x2 body + hole at col 3 → fullRowsOnBoard [23]; next unrelated drop → lines 0→1, score 0→325, attack sent. Well case: 4 full rows → credited 4-line clear. Also affects online FFA host and peer (ffa-p2p-game-state.js:1642, :3374). Either fix is a rules change (clear without credit, deterministic on host and peer; or stop settle into garbage holes) and breaks garbage-boundary holeMask-0 cases.

findings.resolution: fixed (133001a), owner decision 1A: rows a garbage settle completes are cleared at once with no credit

findings.title: Resuming Single Player during a replay drops one gravity tick and un-pauses a replay the viewer had paused
findings.scenario: (a) Pause sheet open/close during a replay: BaseGameMode.onResume sets lastTime = performance.now() (wall clock) but replay lastTime is sim time → next updateGame delta = 0 → that tick's gravity/lock timer/hit-stop lost; each pause/resume shifts gravity phase by one tick → replay can diverge. (b) If paused via the bar's play/pause first, closing the sheet resumes playback anyway while the icon still shows paused.
findings.evidence: BaseGameMode.js:136-151 (:147); SinglePlayerMode.js:484-503 re-anchors only on fixed-tick path and resumes demo unconditionally; :471-479 pausePlayback no-op if already paused; DemoPlayer.js:592-611; game.js:1442-1448, :1119; playback-controls.js:211-218, :244+. Repro: dropCounter 560.00 vs 543.33 after one resume.
findings.fixSketch: onResume with isPlayingDemo: lastTime = simTimeMs; onPause records whether the mode paused the demo; resume only then.
findings.testIdea: Same demo with/without mid onPause/onResume → equal dropCounter and board digest; paused-by-controls stays paused after sheet close.
findings.knownCheck: CORE-01 (live play deltas) and CORE-17 (pacer ignores pause) differ; 11-06 replay fixes concern seek/frame ownership. Not recorded.

verification.summary: verify/gameplay/c3b-trace.test.js: after resume lastTime = wall clock, a frame's gravity lost; c3-resume-gravity-tick.test.js: 1 of 91 move timings gives a different board and score. At 2x/4x the delta becomes a clamped 50 ms burst instead. (b) playback resumes after the viewer paused it; the icon catches up within 100 ms (claim about the icon was wrong). Fix: in SinglePlayerMode.onResume keep the replay clock when isPlayingDemo; resume the demo only if the mode paused it.

findings.title: A saved 0-star Odyssey clear counts as cleared for progress but never grants its orb's theme or the chapter 1/4 reward themes
findings.scenario: Legacy save with a well-formed stars:0 completion (kept on load since dd7e3b0): map shows cleared, next orb opens; ThemeCollectionService.getValidCompletedLevels only accepts 1-3 stars → theme never granted, status says 'Complete Odyssey orb N', chapter 1/4 rewards (thermal-bloom, painted-ages) never fire. Current campaign can't produce new 0-star clears.
findings.evidence: theme-collection-model.js:64-72; theme-collection-service.js:221-266, :255, :150-159; OdysseyStateManager.js:273-296 (minStars 0); REPOSITORY_AUDIT_2026-11-06.md:160 notes older builds produced 0-star clears. Repro: owned [forest, galaxy] missing orb-1 theme and thermal-bloom.
findings.fixSketch: Accept 0-3 stars in getValidCompletedLevels (or reuse normalizeOdysseyCompletion with minStars 0).
findings.testIdea: Every chapter-1 orb completed with stars 0 → themes and thermal-bloom granted; no 'Complete orb' status for cleared orbs.
findings.knownCheck: 11-06 records 0-star local load (dd7e3b0) and cloud merge drop (line 178); nothing on the collection's star filter.

verification.summary: verify/gameplay/c4-zero-star-collection.test.js: v5 save with orbs 1-5 at stars 0 → owned [forest], orb1 status 'Complete Odyssey orb 1'; at stars 1 owns 6 themes + thermal-bloom. Fix: getValidCompletedLevels uses normalizeOdysseyCompletion(completion,{minStars:0}). Cloud merge (1-3 both sides) erases the 0-star clear itself on first merge — a related, recorded-as-deliberate sibling.

findings.resolution: fixed (b4dcf64); owner decision 4A (8a17961): a starless clear counts as cleared everywhere, including the Steam Cloud merge

findings.title: Replay: a pause that lasts until a line clear ends makes the replay skip that frame's recorded inputs while counting them as applied
findings.scenario: Single Player replay at 0.5x or 1x: a hard drop clears a line and the viewer pauses (bar, pad, Escape or focus loss) until the cascade has finished. The in-flight _advanceTo resumes with gameState.isPaused true; its same-frame recorded inputs are refused (core move/rotate and SinglePlayerMode._applyCommand reject while paused) but currentInputIndex still advances, so they are skipped for good and the replay diverges from the recorded game.
findings.evidence: Found by the A18-CORE-1 verifier's pause sweep (scratchpad verify/gameplay/c1-demo-double-loop.test.js): all three inputs recorded in the drop's frame skipped, board digest a71ae2eb vs 9763456b. _advanceTo never checks isPaused. Predates b58561c (not the CORE-1 regression).
findings.fixSketch: In _advanceTo, stop before applying an input while the player is paused (leave currentInputIndex where it is) and let the resumed loop continue from there.
findings.testIdea: Pending physics promise, pause, resolve, flush, resume: every recorded input applied exactly once in order.
findings.knownCheck: Not in any audit record; discovered during verification, not by a discovery auditor.

verification.summary: Reproduced by the verifier on the real DemoPlayer/GameState/pacer under fake timers (digest a71ae2eb vs 9763456b). Not independently re-verified by a second agent; deferred to keep the CORE-1 fix to one concern.

findings.title: Relay network unreachable is never surfaced: lobbies are created/joined and fail as 'host did not answer', contrary to ADR-0023
findings.scenario: Steam client and lobbies work but Valve's SDR relays are unreachable (e.g. firewall blocks relay UDP). The relay transport opens, networkMode stays 'relay'; GetRelayNetworkStatus reports Failed/CannotTry → steam:getNetworkTransport returns {mode:'relay', relayNetwork:'failed'}; _requireRelayTransport refuses only mode==='unavailable', so createLobby/joinLobby proceed. Joiner: every attempt ends 'The host did not answer...' after ~10 s. Host: waiting room stays empty. ADR-0023 promises a clear message.
findings.evidence: electron/steam-integration.js:1184-1188; steam-relay-transport.js:60-63, :295-298, :180 (InitRelayNetworkAccess result unchecked); steam-network-transport.js:27-35 describeNetworkTransport ignores relayNetwork for mode/message; steam-integration.js:451-456; steam-networking.js:420-429; no renderer reader of relayNetwork; join-handshake.js:19,27,65; ADR-0023:38-39.
findings.fixSketch: describeNetworkTransport: relayNetwork 'failed'/'cannot-try' → refusal message; _requireRelayTransport throws it; keep warm-up states allowed.
findings.testIdea: describeNetworkTransport({mode:'relay', relayNetwork:'failed'}) carries a refusal message (currently null); createLobby/joinLobby reject before IPC create/join.
findings.knownCheck: Not in ONLINE_RELAY_TRANSPORT_2026-11.md, ADR-0023, audits, gold-standard audit, plan.

verification.summary: relayNetwork is computed and returned but nothing acts on it (verify/mp/describe-relay-status.mjs: every relay status → message null, lobbyAllowed true). Negative availability states are not terminal (a query or connection attempt triggers a retry), so hard-refusing on a stale 'failed'/'cannot-try' could block a recovered player. ADR-0023 Consequences promise a clear message; ONLINE_RELAY_TRANSPORT limits 'unavailable' to the transport failing to open — docs disagree. Safer fixes: force a retry and poll before refusing, or never block and swap in the relay message when a join ends host_unreachable while relayNetwork is negative. Correction: InitRelayNetworkAccess returns void (nothing to check). Privacy unaffected.

findings.resolution: fixed (37b5f0e, cd3a51e), owner decision 2A: a clear relay message on a failed join or session, a one-time host notice; play never blocked

findings.title: Relay session pump throttled on Date.now(): a backward clock step stops accepting and checking sessions until the clock catches up
findings.scenario: System clock steps back by Δ (time sync after resume, manual change, VM restore) while hosting/in a lobby: relayAcceptedAt/relayCheckedAt stay in the future, so no AcceptSessionWithUser and no session-state reads for Δ. Joiners time out 'host did not answer'; host-handover claimant not accepted; broken sessions not reported; 'connected but not relayed → close' guard paused.
findings.evidence: electron/steam-integration.js:59-62 module-level timestamps; :491-505 pumpRelaySessions with Date.now() comparisons; only accept path; runs from steam:readP2PPacket (:1327-1331).
findings.fixSketch: Use performance.now() (monotonic) for both throttles, or treat now < last as due.
findings.testIdea: Pump at t=100000 then t=40000 with a pending member: accept must be called.
findings.knownCheck: Not recorded; pumpRelaySessions is new since 04b0b613.

verification.summary: vm harness slicing the real pumpRelaySessions (verify/mp/pump-clock.mjs): after a 60 s backward step, 0 accepts in 10 s; new member first accepted after 60.03 s; broken session reported after 60 s. Timestamps only written in the pump, never reset. Fix: performance.now() for both throttles (one file, negligible risk).

findings.title: ADR-0023 session enforcement (pumpRelaySessions / closeRelaySessions / relay read-send branches) has no behavioural test, only source regexes
findings.scenario: Regressions in accept-only-allowed, close-and-report not-relayed sessions, report ended sessions, close all on leave/create/join/quit would pass CI.
findings.evidence: tests/unit/steam-relay-transport.test.js:286-302 regex/string checks only; grep for not-relayed/pumpRelaySessions/closeRelaySessions/relayPeers in tests: none.

findings.title: Portal gate: dispose() during an in-flight off-thread run tears it down twice; the second teardown resizes the transferred canvas (InvalidStateError; the return transition's play() then never resolves)
findings.scenario: Odyssey map: click an orb → JourneyEntryTransition.play() hands its canvas to the worker (transferControlToOffscreen). If Odyssey is deactivated in the first ~0.8 s (quit, GPU-loss route-out, Steam invite), onDeactivate disposes the transition: dispose() calls abort('dispose') (async finish) then teardown() synchronously, which nulls run.remote. finish's finally → fadeOutAndTeardown → teardown(run) again 240 ms later; run.remote is null so it reaches canvas.width = 0 on the transferred canvas → InvalidStateError thrown from a timer. JourneyReturnTransition has the same pattern (teardown 639-661) but its finally calls teardown directly, so the throw rejects with no handler and play() never resolves (returnToOdysseyWorld never clears _boardReturnOperation).
findings.evidence: JourneyEntryTransition.js dispose 136-139, finish 672-719, fadeOutAndTeardown 354-363, teardown 721-746; JourneyReturnTransition.js dispose 145-148, finish 627-636, teardown 639-662; OdysseyMode.js onDeactivate 674, 711-713; throwaway Node repro with stubbed Worker/OffscreenCanvas reproduced both (entry: timer threw InvalidStateError; return: unhandled rejection, play() pending). Existing tests cover normal completion only.
findings.fixSketch: Make teardown idempotent per run (run.tornDown flag) and never resize a transferred canvas (run.handedOver flag); apply to both transition classes.
findings.testIdea: Stub Worker/OffscreenCanvas; canvas width setter throws after transferControlToOffscreen; play() then dispose() mid-run; flush timers. Expect no throw, one 'stop', and return play() resolving {aborted:true, reason:'dispose'}.
findings.knownCheck: Grepped 11-06, 10-22, 10-13 audits, THEME_AND_RENDERING_AUDIT, THEME_AUDIT_HANDOVER, remediation plan for transferControlToOffscreen/portal-gate/JourneyEntryTransition/JourneyReturnTransition: only ODY-11 (unrelated). Off-thread gate landed 2026-11-04, after those audits.

verification.summary: Headless Chromium 157 with real classes, real Worker and real transferControlToOffscreen: entry dispose → uncaught InvalidStateError from the timer; return dispose → unhandled rejection, play() pending (with 0-3 awaits before dispose in onDeactivate). Fix: never size a handed-over canvas (handedOver flag / drop the canvas ref) and make teardown idempotent; Return.finish teardown in try/finally so resolve always fires.
